items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Willard Alexander (Inaudible) called me once when I was up here to go out and do a date for him. I did.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you're one of those fortunate individuals that managed to have a manager, you know, for a long period of time that you were satisfied with, and that you felt was capable of looking out for your interest and his interest. So, I can see why you might, you know, find that to be a good working kind of relationship. Do you think that there are many of those kinds of managers or

I wouldn't know. But, I suppose it is. You know, like Count Basie now. Willard Alexander? Whoever it is, That's a good relation. It keeps him, you know. Willard Alexander (Inaudible) called me once when I was up here to go out and do a date for him. I did. I took a, I had to make that night off for me. It was somewhere in Pennsylvania. Reading? MR. GOINES: Yes. MR. HAWKINS: I think it was Reading, Pennsylvania. It was a big affair. He said that the people wrote to him for me. Then, he had to look and found out…
